title: Platonic friend matching
summary: Like a dating app, but for making friends.
whyTempting: Loneliness is widespread, especially after moving cities.
whyItFails: Low urgency. People don't prioritise making friends. Awkwardness. Meeting strangers for friendship feels odd. Weak monetisation. Hard to charge for friendship.
whatWouldChange: Group-based events and activities that make meeting less awkward.

attempts.outcome: Spun out as a separate app in 2025

reasons.detail: Low urgency: People don't prioritise making friends.
Awkwardness: Meeting strangers for friendship feels odd.
Weak monetisation: Hard to charge for friendship.
